title: Procurement and installation of Air-Conditioner unit for Patpur, Bishnupur, Dimond Harbour FFM station and False Point Lighthouse IQ under Kolkata Directorate.
summary: GeM bid for supply and installation of six 1.5-ton inverter split air conditioners with stabilizers, wiring, MCBs, distribution boards and accessories at the Patpur, Bishnupur and Diamond Harbour FFM (Loran-C) stations and the False Point Lighthouse inspection quarters.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

sites.name: Dimond Harbour FFM Station (Loran-C Station, Diamond Harbour)
sites.work: 1 AC with stabilizer, 10 m wiring, 2 MCBs, 1 MCB DB, GI stand, 15 ft drain pipe, 2 rolls tape, 1 changeover MCB

sites.name: Bishnupur FFM Station (Vishnupur D.N.C Station)
sites.work: 2 ACs with stabilizers, 10 m wiring, 2 MCBs, 1 MCB DB, 2 GI stands, 30 ft drain pipe, 4 rolls tape, 1 changeover MCB

sites.name: Patpur FFM Station (Patpur Loran-C Station)
sites.work: 2 ACs with stabilizers, 10 m wiring, 2 MCBs, 1 MCB DB, 2 GI stands, 30 ft drain pipe, 4 rolls tape, 1 changeover MCB

sites.name: False Point Lighthouse IQ
sites.work: 1 AC with stabilizer, GI stand, 15 ft drain pipe, 2 rolls tape

money.notes: Estimated value Rs 5,32,668 including GST. EMD by DD/FDR/BG or surety bond; MSE (manufacturers/service providers) and NSIC/MSME certificate holders exempt. MII purchase preference 20% (Class 1/2 local suppliers only); MSE purchase preference L1+15% for 25% quantity. Total value wise evaluation; no reverse auction.

period.warranty: Minimum 1 year from purchase/installation or as per OEM whichever is more; defective unit to be replaced within 72 hours

eligibility: Minimum average annual turnover of bidder (3 years) Rs 2 lakh; OEM average turnover Rs 2 lakh (MSE/startup relaxation)
3 years past experience in same/similar service; past performance 80% of bid quantity

ATC: one similar work >= 80% (Rs 4,26,135), or two >= 50% (Rs 2,66,334), or three >= 40% (Rs 2,13,068) of estimated value in last seven years; similar work = SITC of air-conditioner for Central/State Govt/PSU/Autonomous bodies
Average annual turnover >= 30% of estimated amount for last three years ending March 2026 (CA certified)
Solvency certificate for 40% of estimate from commercial bank; ITR for last 3 years
OEM authorization certificate, PAN, GST, bid acceptance form, non-blacklisting affidavit, unconditional bid undertaking, technical compliance sheet
Technical evaluation out of 100 marks (experience 30, performance 30, turnover 15, solvency 10, ITR 15); minimum 70% to qualify (para 4 says 60%)
specs: Air conditioner: 1.5 ton, inverter, 5 star, 4-way swing split, copper condenser coil, 3 m copper pipes
Voltage stabilizer 4 KVA with digital/analog display and time delay
PVC FRLS copper multi-strand cable, 90/100 m roll; makes Finolex/Polycab/KEI/Havells/Anchor/Mescab
Changeover MCB 32 A 2-pole 240 V 50 Hz 2-module; makes Anchor/Havells/Legrand/Crabtree
Wiring per Odisha State Electricity Board specs, else CPWD General Specifications for Electrical Works 2025; Indian Electricity Act 2003 / Rules 1956
BOQ items 3-5 are labour with materials as per DSR-2025
notes: Scanned print of GeM bid document (25 pages) followed by DLL Kolkata ATC, forms A-D, scope of work, technical specs and BOQ. GeM bid end 08-09-2026 19:00 and opening 08-09-2026 19:30; listing shows end 2026-09-09.
